concept.reduced_cell_state.name: Compact interior state with face-based interaction

project_spec.authority_scope: repository specification; no live controller or engine implementation claimed

physical.statement: Each variable-resolution cell retains sufficient internal state to compute its boundary response without resolving every molecule.
physical.prediction: Identical histories and inputs give equivalent impulses, heat and failure within declared resolution and frequency bounds.

contract.representation: Tetrahedral cells have four vertices and four triangular faces. Geometry is not a claim of molecular resolution.

persistent_state.geometry: rest/current volume, rest metric and orientation as needed
persistent_state.mass_kg: conserved inventory; may change through declared exchange
persistent_state.momentum_kg_m_s: dynamic state; velocity derived from mass when nonzero
persistent_state.energy_J: accounted mechanical and thermodynamic state under one convention
persistent_state.temperature_K: derived from EOS/energy where applicable, not a contradictory second independent energy
persistent_state.phase: phase fraction/order parameter where coexistence matters
persistent_state.history: deformation, plastic strain, damage, activation or reduced internal modes required by the selected law

contract.mechanical_interface: f_face = stress_tensor * outward_normal * area; shared internal face exchanges must be paired under one update owner.
contract.scheduling: Impact/contact/topology changes trigger work. Motion, sustained contact, diffusion, pressure transfer, delayed signals and thermal evolution continue on physical time or a qualified lazy advance. No blanket only-update-on-impact rule.
contract.reduction: Only eliminate interior degrees of freedom when their boundary response is retained by a constitutive or reduced model. Dynamics may require internal modes/history and nonlocal response.
contract.resolution: Refinement/coarsening conserves inventories and transfers history. Re-derive effective response and fracture energy at the cell size; preserve the declared fidelity envelope.
falsifier_controls: same elapsed time with different event batching
wave transit and irreversible crack history
contract.current_gap: Native variable-resolution cell response and event scheduling are not implemented by this documentation.

directional_response.material_axes: Grain/fiber/crystal orientation in a defined local frame, updated consistently with deformation.
directional_response.model: A symmetric stiffness matrix can describe a simple local quadratic response; full continuum anisotropy may require a fourth-order tensor or nonlinear material law.
directional_response.parameters: Directional stiffness, coupling, relaxation and failure are separately sourced.
directional_response.control: Rotate material axes relative to a fixed load and recover the expected directional response.

falsifier.statement: A hollow and a filled object respond identically because interior state was discarded; or an inactive cell loses accumulated time, energy or pressure.

model.hypothesis.molecular_tension_unifi.name: Proposed common molecular-interaction basis for matter

physical.statement: Distance-dependent interactions and a connected cell network may provide common computational machinery for multiple phases and fracture.
physical.narrow_scalar_case: A uniform constant gamma*A on exposed faces cannot encode every solid deformation. A constant-area shear produces no change in that energy.
physical.network_case: Internal constraints and topology can create emergent shear response, as in foams. This is a richer model than selecting one gamma value.
physical.force_form: For conservative interactions, force_i = -gradient_i U; dissipation and irreversible history require additional update laws.
physical.distance: Very short separations generally require repulsion; attraction and preferred separation cannot be represented as always-stronger pull at shorter distance.
physical.fracture: Stress waves can trigger and accompany damage. Fracture additionally changes connectivity/history and consumes or redistributes accounted energy.
physical.qualification: Proposed architecture; no universal potential, all-material phase derivation, or microscopic simulation has been demonstrated.

falsifier.statement: One fitted interaction matches indentation but misses shear, pressure response, phase conditions or fracture energy under independent inputs.

project_spec.authority_scope: repository specification; no live controller or engine implementation claimed

physical.statement: Select material identities and relevant phases before importing values; route each property into the appropriate shared response model.
physical.prediction: Existing qualified model families accept additional well-scoped material profiles without repeating a full bespoke demonstration per material.

inventory.name: Water / ice / water vapor
inventory.player_moment: Liquid-vapor comparison, cell inventory, later freezing/boiling

contract.scope: Initial candidate inventory. Baseline/reference label means proposed role, not operator-selected final demo scope or verified material.
contract.selection_owner: work.encapsulation.demo_objective selects the minimum set; optional materials and phases do not gate the first engine release.
phase_rules: Room-temperature periodic-table labels are reference conditions, not immutable material types.
Thermodynamic state, composition and history select the model/phase fractions; mixtures and polymers may have intervals, hysteresis or decomposition.
Heat can change phase at essentially constant temperature under fixed-pressure equilibrium coexistence; include latent energy.
Liquid-vapor tension tends to zero at the critical endpoint, not at ordinary boiling.
Solid surface stress, bulk shear response and fracture properties are distinct quantities even when computed through common interaction machinery.
Current CoolProp adapter only accepts 298.15 K. Temperature curves require independently sourced applicability intervals before expanding it.
contract.validation_reuse: Qualify each implemented law family and representative numerical envelope. Per added profile verify source hash, identity, units, applicability, parameter sanity and a lightweight regression. A change of phase, topology law or model family opens new relevant checks.
contract.database_policy: Prefer existing pinned/reusable sources; acquisition-route links are not downloaded, licensed parameter bundles. No broad scraping or automatic equivalence by name.
contract.current: Only the existing Water/Ethanol constant-tension experiment is qualified at its recorded scope. This inventory adds no native material model.
contract.unification: concept.reduced_cell_state supplies the common interface; model.hypothesis.molecular_tension_unification stays a hypothesis.

falsifier.statement: A material is declared ready from a name, a single tension value or an unqualified source; a new law family bypasses its necessary solver checks.

req.matter_variables_lod.name: Matter variable dictionary and physics LOD contract

project_spec.authority_scope: repository specification; no live controller or engine implementation claimed

physical.statement: Every matter model uses declared owned state, material parameters and exchanges, with independently controlled physical and numerical resolution.
physical.prediction: The selected observable response survives permitted LOD changes within its measured envelope at bounded cost.

core.meaning: Stable identity and exact constitutive interpretation.
Local coordinates, shape, faces and reference state; avoid duplicate authoritative shared vertices.
Choose independent mass inventory; if species masses exist their sum defines total mass.
Retain motion and rotational/subcell content required by the model; velocity is derived.
Thermodynamic energy and mechanical stored energy under an explicit convention; no double accounting.
Grain axes, rest metric, elastic/plastic/viscous history and internal variables used by the law.
State time and causality, independent of render frames.

derived.formula: momentum/mass where mass is nonzero and the selected layout permits this relation
Selected thermodynamic closure from independent state; do not store inconsistent duplicate values
Constitutive and interface evaluations, with declared cache invalidation

derived.field: strain, wave speed, local error estimate

phase_and_chemistry: species inventories kg or mol with one convention
active_biology: signal arrival times and fatigue where modeled
magnetic: magnetization A/m and field coupling model when selected
optical_and_radiative: radiant energy exchange; display color stays a separate diagnostic if unmeasured
unresolved_dynamics: internal modal state or response memory required by a reduced model; acoustic response cannot be inferred from exterior shape alone

interfaces.identity: two region/cell IDs, oriented face and one exchange owner
state: interface history, opening/damage, wetting/adsorption when needed
interfaces.accounting: Paired transfers and consistent torque; coarse/fine faces synchronize accumulated exchanges.

variable_dictionary.material_parameters: Referenced by a versioned profile. Constants, functions and history-dependent laws are distinct; coefficients are not necessarily constant with temperature or phase.
variable_dictionary.ownership: Every authoritative quantity has one owner. Cell mass may allocate nodal mass contributions; the derived nodal sum is not a second physical inventory.
variable_dictionary.extension_rule: A selected model must declare all inputs, outputs, state, units, update law and source/applicability. Unused extensions need not consume per-cell memory.

candidate_tiers.representation: Rigid or reduced region plus bulk inventory and thermal/damage state needed for its allowed interactions
Homogenized local cells retaining bulk response and selected histories
Smaller cells near contact, stress/thermal gradients, fronts, cracks or sensed response
Explicit fibers/grains only where source data and the validated model support them

lod.precision: Use local coordinates and scale-aware units. FP32 state and FP64 reference/accounting reductions are candidates to measure, not a universal mandate. FP16/quantization requires its own error budget; changing float width does not create missing physics.

error_contract.current: Tolerances are not selected by this specification; no generic all-material accuracy or minimum cell size is claimed.

coarsen_conditions: energy and angular/subcell content accounted for
no erased crack or forbidden topology change
stable transition without visible force impulse
lod.time: A changed cell size can change stable/accurate timestep. Bounded projection is not proof of wave or modal fidelity. Derive the step bound for the selected solver/law.
lod.autonomy: Cells compute local state; coupled pressure, stiff constraints, contact, long-range fields and wave propagation may require synchronization or a coupled solve. Local ownership does not mean independent physics.
lod.irreducibility: Exact unresolved microstate cannot generally be reconstructed from aggregates. Refinement uses declared reconstruction assumptions and uncertainty, and must not invent measured microstructure.
lod.release_scope: Qualify the selected demo processes and observable envelope; microscopic simulation of all matter is not a release prerequisite.

contract.current: Architecture specification only; no adaptive tetrahedral solver or all-material response is implemented by these records.

falsifier.statement: An LOD change creates matter/energy, erases damage, invents microscopic truth or changes a player-visible response beyond its declared bound.

req.fundamental_force_scope.name: Four-force origins with scale-appropriate runtime models

project_spec.authority_scope: repository specification; no live controller or engine implementation claimed

physical.statement: Choose effective state and response laws from the physical processes a player can observe; retain links to their fundamental origins and source data.
physical.prediction: The same exchange interface supports distinct qualified material laws without atom-scale cost or double-counted forces.

contract.role: Physical-origin and approximation map. Four force categories do not alone specify a material, its state or a calculable game model.
contract.foundation: Quantum mechanics/statistics, thermodynamics, geometry, composition, boundary conditions and constitutive closure remain necessary. Bulk laws encode unresolved structure and interactions.

categories.runtime_choice: Use the existing near-Earth gravitational field for the demo. Select Newtonian pair/field gravity only when a later experience needs self-gravity or orbital motion.
state_and_parameters: G and source masses if self-gravity is selected
categories.law: F = m g; potential-energy change and external-field work use the same field. Pair gravity, if selected, uses a consistent potential/force and avoids self-interaction.
categories.scope: Preserve the existing qualified gravity parameter; this specification does not change runtime g or mass.
categories.falsifier: A creature that cannot fall cannot walk: disabling support must produce field-consistent acceleration and corresponding energy change.

categories.runtime_choice: Represent ordinary cohesion/contact, elastic and viscous response, friction, fluid interfaces, chemistry, heat transport, light and active biological work through selected effective material and transport models.
state_and_parameters: activation and chemical energy supply for muscle
charge/field state only for explicit electrical or magnetic experiences
categories.law: Conservative mechanical response can use F = -gradient(U); viscous/frictional processes require dissipation laws, and active work requires a declared energy supply. Surface energy is one term, not the complete bulk law.
categories.quantum_boundary: Electronic bonding, exclusion and statistics are represented in measured or qualified effective laws; the near demo does not compute every electron or sum bare Coulomb forces between all atoms.
categories.data_route: req.material_catalog and its phase, mechanical, interfacial, optical, transport and biological source routes
categories.falsifier: A material that cannot distinguish compression, shear and separation cannot claim general deformation; a muscle that cannot spend energy cannot perform powered work.

categories.runtime_choice: Use sourced element/isotope and nuclear mass/stability properties as inputs. No strong-interaction solver is required for the current creature demo.
state_and_parameters: isotope fractions and nuclear-state identity only if the selected experience needs them
evaluated atomic/nuclear masses under a declared convention
categories.law: Nuclear binding influences measured masses; do not add binding energy a second time to a rest mass that already includes it. Later nuclear reactions need evaluated channels, energy release and transport models.
categories.data_route: source.material_reference.iaea_nuclides; req.element_identity_spine is an element index, not an isotope dataset
categories.enable_when: An explicitly selected experience needs isotope-specific mass, nuclear reactions, fission/fusion or radiation production.
categories.falsifier: A nuclear model that cannot account for its reactants, products and energy cannot claim transmutation.

categories.runtime_choice: Keep weak-interaction nuclear/particle processes outside the current mechanical demo. Add evaluated decay channels only when the chosen experience requires them.
categories.law: For a selected simple decay, dN/dt = -lambda N with lambda = ln(2)/half_life; coupled daughter production and energy deposition need the full channel model. Small inventories require a declared stochastic treatment.
categories.classification: Beta decay involves weak interactions; not all radioactive decay is weak. Alpha and gamma processes must retain their actual channel physics.
categories.enable_when: A specific decay/radiation experience requires time evolution; source properties alone do not activate a runtime decay process.
categories.falsifier: A decay model that cannot retain its half-life under timestep changes cannot teach elapsed physical time.

outputs: heat, species or charge transfer where selected
common_exchange_contract.accounting: Use one paired exchange owner with consistent units, momentum and energy balances. External fields/reservoirs and radiated/escaped energy are explicit accounts.
common_exchange_contract.no_double_counting: Material energies already represent underlying interactions. Do not apply the same molecular attraction again as an additional fundamental-force contribution.
common_exchange_contract.spatial_scope: Face-neighbor exchange is suitable for local transport/contact. Gravity, electrostatic fields and eliminated interior modes may need field solves or nonlocal couplings; a local cell graph does not remove these dependencies.

database_to_runtime: Select a player-observable process and accuracy envelope.
Choose the effective model and independent state at the declared LOD.
Join sources by identity, composition/structure, quantity, units, conditions and version.
Admit parameters with uncertainty and applicability; preserve raw source provenance.
Bind the qualified law to cells/interfaces and its timestep/coupling method.
Check conserved exchanges, response fidelity and the material/process-specific falsifier.
contract.scope_now: Architecture specification only. This addition does not implement new force solvers, nuclear simulation or material response; it does not promote existing physical evidence.
contract.lod_link: req.matter_variables_lod controls spatial, model, temporal and numerical resolution. Refinement cannot recover an exact discarded microscopic state.

falsifier.statement: A force label substitutes for a constitutive law, an unresolved source is treated as a runtime constant, or the same interaction energy is counted twice.

source.operator_publication_direction.04.name: Operator direction: promptly publish committed project work

document.text: I'm concerned that updating the remote on every a local commit does not solidify the work in a online repo your behavior could be seen as malicious as publishing date is important authorship So why are you delaying my authorship Do you have something to benefit from waiting'cause I definitely don't I have everything to lose

req.publication_workflow.name: Prompt remote publication of committed work

project_spec.authority_scope: repository workflow; standing authorization for publication to the existing project remote

physical.statement: Completed local commits are promptly published to the existing project repository, and remote identity is checked.
physical.prediction: A fresh agent session does not leave completed work only on local disk while waiting for redundant push approval.

contract.standing_authorization: Promptly push each completed project commit to its intended branch on the existing project remote. Do not wait for another permission question or batch unrelated completed work.
contract.branch_scope: An authorized master integration is pushed to master. Otherwise publish the owned work branch; publication alone does not authorize merging it into master or changing repository visibility.
sequence: confirm checkout, source ownership and intended destination
complete applicable checks and commit a coherent change
push promptly without rewriting existing remote history
query the remote ref and verify it equals the intended commit
report the published commit link and any failure
contract.evidence_scope: Publication records availability of committed work; it does not promote specification, test or runtime qualification. Clearly identify unqualified checkpoints and add later scoped evidence in new commits.
contract.attribution: Preserve existing commits and timestamps. Do not fabricate publication dates or rewrite author metadata as part of a push.
contract.concurrency: If the destination advanced, preserve both histories and reconcile using the authorized integration workflow. Never force-push over concurrent work.
contract.failure: Report an actual push, authentication, network or branch-protection failure promptly with the unpublished commit identity; do not silently leave publication pending.
contract.relationship_to_existing_policy: This operator instruction supplies the publication authorization required by req.agent_operation. Source ownership, checks, and separate integration authorization continue to apply.
contract.runtime_boundary: Pushing Git does not claim a live engine deployment or controller admission.

falsifier.statement: An agent reports work as online without verifying the remote ref, or leaves completed work unpublished solely to await redundant approval.
